0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the 76ers, who are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East after a road win. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (out, ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps). Cleveland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 115-101 home win on March 9, 2026.
